key_insight: BoT-GRPO replaces GRPO’s uniform token credit with length-invariant bag-of-tokens aggregation over token-level rewards, enabling faster and better reasoning learning without a critic/value network.
engineering_relevance: It is a drop-in RL upgrade for token-level reward settings that can speed convergence and improve final quality in theorem proving, code generation, and math reasoning.
method: Aggregate all token-level rewards across rollouts with inverse sequence-length weighting.
Compute per-token advantages from weighted group statistics instead of assigning one shared rollout advantage.
Use a critic-free, process-reward RL objective that works wherever GRPO is used with token-level feedback.
evidence_signal: Across React code generation and AIME reasoning, BoT-GRPO reached 80% compile rate up to 1.9× faster than GRPO and improved Pass@k by up to 8.1% in half the steps, with better final win/compile rates than several GRPO variants.
watch_item: The gains depend on having reliable token-level reward signals, so noisy or unstable reward models may reduce or stall the benefit.
paper_title: BoT-GRPO: Efficient Process-Reward RL for Reasoning via Bag-of-Token Aggregation
